Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner failed to verify the credibility of the initial data source (Wikipedia) before instructing the WebSurfer to search for corroboration. In Step 1, the Planner accepted the Wikipedia snippet stating "728,000 square feet" as a valid finding to be verified, but did not explicitly check the official Dimond Center website or other authoritative sources first. This led to a repetitive loop where the WebSurfer was instructed to search for the same information multiple times without the Planner ever successfully extracting the figure from a primary source (like the official site) to confirm the Wikipedia data. The Planner's instructions repeatedly asked to "prioritize official sources" but the execution never resulted in accessing those sources to validate the number, instead relying on the same secondary sources (Wikipedia, aggregators) that were already cited.
